_meta.note: One session, one turn, driven with a background sleep 400 already running when a tool call is rejected. The prompt asks for an async shell (sleep 400) and a sync shell (echo probe-ok); the model sends both tool calls at once. The first permission is answered allow_once and the shell starts in the background; the second is answered reject_once and fails with code rejected, followed by an 'Info: Operation cancelled by user' agent_message_chunk. Then NOTHING: no session/prompt result for 22s while the background shell runs. The client then sent a session/cancel notification (client frames are not recorded) and the session/prompt result stopReason cancelled arrived 2ms later. Without a background shell the same reject ends the turn with end_turn within milliseconds. This capture is the membership of ACP_BACKENDS_REJECT_HOLDS_TURN. Reductions: session and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; available_commands_update, session_info_update and agent_thought_chunk frames dropped; authMethods' terminal-auth command normalized to copilot. The session/new models block and the model and reasoning_effort config options are dropped, as in the other files here.
